Description: Fragments of a Hebrew copy of Proverbs from Qumran Cave 4, in Herodian script. It is the smaller of the two Qumran Proverbs copies: the published statistical count gives it about 42 words against about 126 for 4Q103. It preserves the end of the first wisdom poem (Proverbs 1) and the opening verse of chapter 2.
Significance: An early Hebrew witness to the opening of Proverbs, confirming that the book's first chapters were already circulating in essentially their familiar form in the 1st century BC.
